field_edits.updated_text: Mild levoconvex curvature of the lumbar spine. Lumbar vertebral body heights are maintained. No acute compression deformity is seen. Alignment is maintained without spondylolisthesis. Mild degenerative changes of the sacroiliac joints are present. Normal density and alignment. No fracture or osseous lesion.
There is mild disc space narrowing at L4-L5 and L5-S1. The remaining disc spaces are preserved.
Moderate retained colonic stool burden is noted.

impression:
1. Mild multilevel lumbar spondylosis with lower lumbar facet arthropathy.
2. Mild levoconvex lumbar scoliosis.
3. Mild degenerative disc disease with disc space narrowing at L4-L5 and L5-S1 and small endplate osteophytes.
4. Mild degenerative changes of the sacroiliac joints.
5. Moderate retained colonic stool burden.
6. No acute osseous abnormality.
